reference.unit: One canonical icons/*.json entry. Excludes aliases as independent icons, Lab, and package exports.

methodology.exact_name: Same canonical name, excluding known semantic collisions and contextual shape/state mismatches. Does not certify artwork quality.
methodology.semantic_equivalent: Editorially reviewed alternate local name with the same principal intent. No API alias is created by this report. Many-to-one mappings are permitted and disclosed.
methodology.missing: No strong existing equivalent established; includes known same-name collisions. Similar category, shared tags and broad metaphors are insufficient.
methodology.contextual_match: Same name with a reviewed shape/state mismatch. Not included in strong coverage; needs original drawing correction or a distinct explicit variant.
methodology.categories: Recursively resolve Lucide $extends: categories, deduplicate in source order. Primary category is the first resolved category, used only for disjoint totals.
methodology.limitations: This is a coverage and naming audit, not full visual verification. Contextual matches require separate artwork/state correction and are excluded from strong coverage. Directional text equivalents are LTR only.

extension_progress.visual_review_status: 29 delivered names passed the separate expansion audit. Handshake was deferred after ambiguous 16-point review.
extension_progress.deferral_reason: Final handshake prototype did not resolve as interlocking hands at 16 points and was removed rather than accepted.
